purpose: Append-only registry of relative-momentum definitions evaluated by FairEntry.

experiments.benchmark: sector ETF mapped from the existing FairEntry sector
experiments.improving_rule: six-month stock-minus-sector return is above 0% and higher than it was 21 trading sessions earlier
experiments.deteriorating_rule: six-month stock-minus-sector return is below 0% and lower than it was 21 trading sessions earlier
experiments.primary_outcome: +30% within 365 days from the earliest official Buy
